field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Include the mandated Qwen3.8 GGUF for every LLM call.
field_principles.adapter_isolation_receipt: A withheld-adapter claim requires an observed policy access boundary.
field_principles.arc_session_complete_score: A terminal scheduled session can honestly contain zero useful inductions.
field_principles.completion_receipts: Raw completion hashes preserve every actual model response.
field_principles.cumulative_induction_rows: Only authenticated distinct inductions count toward the cumulative target.
field_principles.demand_observation: Report observed demand and limitations over the exact denominator.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic work time; do not pad it to pass a floor.
field_principles.execution_host: Put the actual hostname here, never inside execution_venue.
field_principles.execution_venue: Use exactly host, kv260, gatemate or polarfire; these tasks execute on host.
field_principles.experiment_id: Bind the terminal receipt to the V635 task identity.
field_principles.field_principles: Echo the reason for each field beside its actual evidence.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* verdict names failed check, upstream, field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.gpu_receipts: Task-owned CUDA evidence must overlap actual model work.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete_ or complete: for completed findings; blocked_* for external absence. Readiness is not scientific value.
field_principles.inference_mode: Use live_gpu only when task-owned CUDA work was sampled.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe executed computation, not the intended workload.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The actual operation determines its duration floor.
field_principles.model_identity_receipt: Record repository ID, revision, GGUF hash and actual runtime.
field_principles.model_specs: Keep the actual resolved model beside the mandated model declaration.
field_principles.new_solve_claimed: False because r11l has already been reproduced.
field_principles.official_leaderboard_score_reported: This cumulative session is not an official submission.
field_principles.optional_source_receipts: Missing sibling output is visible and nonblocking.
field_principles.paired_efficacy_reported: False because the two new sessions are replication units, not causal arms.
field_principles.per_game_results: Keep the full session denominator, banked levels and action count.
field_principles.phase_spans: Separate loading, prefill, generation, parsing and verification costs.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record the actual resource, code and gate observations.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze stochastic choices before held-out outcomes are read.
field_principles.registered_level_increment: A repeated known game cannot increment the solve registry.
field_principles.registry_reproduction_receipt: The evaluator confirms r11l was reproduced before launch.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash the inputs, code, settings and raw rows.
field_principles.rows: Keep unit_id, arm, seed, metric, error and abstention for each comparison; do not replace numeric rows with a task roster.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260911; do not substitute an upstream experiment date.
field_principles.runner_receipt: Model count and execution runner explain compute allocation.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Retain planned, attempted, completed, censored and independent-unit counts.
field_principles.schema: A versioned schema lets cumulative consumers reject incompatible rows.
field_principles.session_receipt: The bounded child terminal state distinguishes zero evidence from no run.
field_principles.solve_provenance: Use live_agent_self_discovery for the reachable policy path.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Bind source code, input data and frozen contracts to the claim.
field_principles.status: Write a terminal artifact only after completion or a diagnosed external block.
field_principles.submitted: The experiment must not alter or submit the live default.
field_principles.tool_induction_rows: Unique IDs and per-name events prevent duplicated or lost tool evidence.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial; only incomplete own work can be partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Same correctness authority remains circular even with a separate implementation.
